form.label: AU-2 Linux Audit Events
form.description: Linux event visibility for the 13 AU-2 groups and 57 required action/outcome cases. Observations are evidence leads, not automatic control passes.

search.query: | `au2_linux_events` | eval linux_evidence_hint=coalesce(linux_evidence_hint,"Needs source-specific mapping"), test_id=coalesce(test_id,"Additional test needed"), validation_state="Needs Validation" | bin _time span=15m | stats count AS event_count latest(event_summary) AS sample_summary values(source) AS source values(sourcetype) AS sourcetype latest(linux_evidence_hint) AS linux_evidence_hint latest(test_id) AS test_id latest(validation_state) AS validation_state BY _time event_host au2_requirement au2_group au2_action event_outcome au2_case_id local_catalog | eval record_kind="observed" | append [ | inputlookup au2_linux_event_catalog.csv | rename event_group AS au2_group event_action AS au2_action required_outcome AS event_outcome record_id AS au2_case_id | eval _time=now(), event_count=0, event_host="Expected matrix", record_kind="expected", source="", sourcetype="", sample_summary="" ]
search record_kind="observed" | stats sum(event_count) AS events BY event_host | sort 0 event_host

html.p: Observed means the search found a matching Linux event in the selected window. It does not prove fleet-wide collection, required retention, AU-3 content completeness, review, or assessor acceptance. Missing results can indicate either a real logging gap or a source/field mapping gap. Raw command arguments and event bodies are not displayed.
The matrix stays visible even when no event exists, so a quiet data source cannot make an AU-2 requirement disappear.

search.query: search record_kind="observed" au2_requirement=$requirement_tok|s$ event_outcome=$outcome_tok|s$ | where $host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$ | stats sum(event_count) AS value | eval value=coalesce(value,0)

search record_kind="observed" au2_requirement=$requirement_tok|s$ event_outcome=$outcome_tok|s$ | where $host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$ | stats dc(event_host) AS value | eval value=coalesce(value,0)

single.title: Required cases with an observed lead

search.query: search au2_requirement=$requirement_tok|s$ event_outcome=$outcome_tok|s$ | where record_kind="expected" OR $host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$ | stats sum(eval(if(record_kind="observed",event_count,0))) AS observed_events max(eval(if(record_kind="expected",1,0))) AS expected_case BY au2_case_id | stats count(eval(expected_case=1 AND observed_events>0)) AS observed_cases count(eval(expected_case=1)) AS expected_cases | eval value=observed_cases." / ".expected_cases

search record_kind="observed" au2_requirement=$requirement_tok|s$ event_outcome="failure" | where $host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$ | stats sum(event_count) AS value | eval value=coalesce(value,0)

search record_kind="observed" au2_requirement=$requirement_tok|s$ event_outcome=$outcome_tok|s$ | where $host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$ | timechart span=15m sum(event_count) AS events BY event_outcome useother=f usenull=f

search record_kind="observed" au2_requirement=$requirement_tok|s$ event_outcome=$outcome_tok|s$ | where $host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$ | stats sum(event_count) AS events BY au2_requirement | eval sort_order=tonumber(replace(au2_requirement,"AU-2.a.","")) | sort 0 sort_order | fields - sort_order

table.title: Complete AU-2 action/outcome matrix — all 57 required cases

search.query: search au2_requirement=$requirement_tok|s$ event_outcome=$outcome_tok|s$ | where record_kind="expected" OR $host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$ | stats sum(eval(if(record_kind="observed",event_count,0))) AS observed_events max(eval(if(record_kind="expected",1,0))) AS expected_case values(eval(if(record_kind="observed",event_host,null()))) AS observed_hosts latest(au2_group) AS event_group latest(local_catalog) AS local_catalog latest(test_id) AS test_id latest(linux_evidence_hint) AS linux_evidence_hint BY au2_case_id au2_requirement au2_action event_outcome | where expected_case=1 | eval evidence_state=if(observed_events>0,"Observed lead — validation required","No matching event — Needs Validation"), sort_order=tonumber(replace(au2_requirement,"AU-2.a.","")) | sort 0 sort_order au2_action event_outcome | table au2_requirement event_group au2_action event_outcome observed_events observed_hosts evidence_state local_catalog test_id linux_evidence_hint

chart.title: Top Linux hosts by matching events

search.query: search record_kind="observed" au2_requirement=$requirement_tok|s$ event_outcome=$outcome_tok|s$ | where $host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$ | stats sum(event_count) AS events BY event_host | sort 10 - events

search record_kind="observed" au2_requirement=$requirement_tok|s$ event_outcome=$outcome_tok|s$ | where $host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$ | stats sum(event_count) AS events latest(_time) AS latest_event values(source) AS sources BY sourcetype | convert ctime(latest_event) | sort 0 - events

table.title: Matching Linux event detail — sanitized fields, newest first

search.query: | `au2_linux_events` | search au2_requirement=$requirement_tok|s$ event_outcome=$outcome_tok|s$ | where $host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$ | sort 0 - _time | table _time event_host event_source_ip au2_requirement au2_group au2_action event_outcome event_actor event_process event_object audit_type audit_key audit_syscall source sourcetype event_summary
